name: Open a program and complete a lesson
description: Verifies the main learning workflow opens a program lesson and records completion.
steps: From Learning Home, open NAMI Connection Recovery Support Group
Use the lesson completion control to mark the lesson learned
expected: The lesson shows as completed and the Learning Studio remains navigable.

name: Use unified Story Mode
description: Verifies Story Mode is the single support-group simulator while preserving focused scenario content.
steps: Open a focused scenario and make a decision
expected: Both long-form and focused branching practice live under one Story Mode navigation item and continue to provide decisions and debriefs.

name: Use mobile navigation and Matrix audio controls
description: Verifies the iPhone-sized layout can navigate to Themes, activate Matrix, and use labeled audio controls.
steps: Go to Themes and choose Matrix Terminal
expected: The mobile menu is usable, controls have accessible names, and no theme panel obscures Learning Home.

name: Search for a known learning topic
description: Verifies the Studio can search its learning content and open a matching result.
steps: Use Search the studio to search for privacy
expected: At least one relevant result is shown and the selected result opens inside the Learning Studio.

name: Use Star Wars theme media controls
description: Verifies the Star Wars theme uses one soundtrack controller and reusable background package rotation.
steps: Confirm the 53-track Saga soundtrack browser appears once
Confirm background video is muted and rotation-controlled
expected: Star Wars remains stable, media controls are labeled, and background playback rotates through the package instead of looping one clip forever.
